subject: Ledger lock: final invoice acceptance & VAT residency proof request

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@equinox-labs.com>

Subject: Final invoice acceptance and VAT residency docs

Hi Karthik,

We've completed our internal review and are ready to accept the final invoice for the renewal/true-up period, pending a couple of items from your side so our AP can run the ledger lock this week:

1) The final PDF invoice with line-level usage reconciled to the May 2026 usage report (we need invoice PDF that clearly shows the usage credits applied).
2) A VAT residency certificate or tax residency confirmation for Redwood (EU reverse-charge needs evidence for our finance team).
3) A clear PO reference to put on the payment (our PO 987654 needs to be on the invoice).

Can you send the updated invoice and the residency doc by end of day Tuesday? If not, please tell me the earliest time so we can hold our ledger lock accordingly — AP is planning the close on Wednesday morning CET.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Blake
Head of Procurement
Equinox Labs

Thanks Ethan — we can do that. Attaching the updated final invoice (PDF) with the PO number and the VAT residency doc. A few notes:

- Invoice: RW_Final_Invoice_EqLabs_Q2_2026.pdf shows the usage true-up lines and the applied usage credit line (Credit: -$12,450). We preserved the per-product usage rows you reviewed in the draft.
- VAT: Equinox asked for residency evidence; attached "Equinox_VAT_Residency_Certificate.pdf" is the customer-supplied certificate that we validate against the EU reverse-charge checklist. For clarity, Redwood's tax profile indicates we will not be charging VAT on this invoice if the reverse-charge applies, provided your residency doc is accepted by AP.
- Routing: please confirm whether payment should go to the standard Redwood bank account on the invoice or to the escrow account (we included escrow as a fallback in the invoice notes).

Next steps for AP:
- If you accept the attached PDF as-is, we can publish the final invoice to your portal and sign off; Marissa will coordinate payment timing/any credits.

Marissa/Monica — looping you in to confirm payment routing and ledger lock timing. If AP requires a DocuSign or signed statement for the residency document, let me know and I'll send the link.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Ethan — thanks for the heads up and thanks Karthik for the attachments. Quick operational notes from finance: 

- We've verified the PO 987654 is on the PDF and that the credit line maps to our internal rebate code. Good.
- Equinox's VAT certificate passes our initial residency check; however, AP needs the certificate on a signed page (they prefer a scanned certificate with the company stamp). Could you confirm you have a stamped copy? If not, we accept a formal emailed attest from an authorized signatory (name + title + company).
- Payment routing: Redwood bank account (IBAN provided on invoice) is preferred. If you'd like to push to escrow for now, please confirm in reply with a line that explicitly says "Pay to escrow" and include the beneficiary name.

Timing: If we receive the stamped certificate or emailed attest by EOD Tuesday CET (26 May 2026 18:00 CET), Finance will include the invoice in the Wednesday ledger lock and schedule payment net 30 as per the renewal SLA. If not, we'll have to roll the invoice into the next close window (mid-June).

Let me know and we'll move it to ledger lock.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
